welcome.title: Welcome to Pockito
welcome.tagline: Personal and shared money, kept simple.
welcome.note: Pockito uses a secure sign-in page. Your password is never entered in this app.

profile.title: What should we call you?
profile.body: This is the name Pockito will use to greet you and show you to anyone you share money with.

avatar.title: Add a photo
avatar.body: Optional. Without one, Pockito shows your initials.

language.title: Choose your language
language.body: You can change this at any time in Settings.

currency.title: Set your default currency
currency.body: Pockito uses this as the starting point for new amounts.

avatar.hint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 2 MB.

home.subtitle: Your Pockito account is ready.
home.readyBody: Expenses, budgets and shared spaces arrive in the next release. Your profile and preferences are already saved to your account, so they will follow you to every device.

settings.title: Settings
settings.identity: Signed in as {email}. Your email and password are managed by the Pockito sign-in service.
settings.sessionBody: Signing out ends this session on this device.

errors.transient: Pockito is having trouble right now. Please try again in a moment.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network.unreachable: We can't reach Pockito. Check your connection and try again.
errors.auth.unauthenticated: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.access.denied: You don't have permission to do that.
errors.validation.failed: Please check the details you entered.
errors.profile.display_name.blank: Your display name can't be empty.
errors.profile.display_name.too_long: Your display name is too long.
errors.avatar.too_large: That image is too large. The limit is 2 MB.
errors.avatar.unsupported_type: Please choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
errors.avatar.empty: That file appears to be empty.
errors.core.unreachable: Pockito is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.
